gp.message:
================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO MAKA AFTER EFFECTS - IHE ỌHỤRỤ
Nsụgharị 9.2.8  -  Ọktọba 2026
================================================================================

Panel ahụ na-asụ ASỤSỤ 132 ugbu a, e nwekwara THEME DEMON SLAYER ọhụrụ nwere
mma agha na-egbutu bọtịnụ ndị ị pịrọ, na ụfọdụ mmezi nhazi na nke Windows.

TUPU Ị MALITE
- Wụnye ya n'elu nsụgharị ị nwere ugbu a site na ZXP installer gị nkịtị, wee malitegharịa
  After Effects otu ugboro.
- A ga-edebe ntọala gị, theme gị, preset gị na expressions ị chekwara.

ỌHỤRỤ: PANEL N'ASỤSỤ 132
- Flex Ntọala > ASỤSỤ na-edepụta asụsụ 132 ugbu a, nwere igbe ọchọcha. Họrọ
  otu, panel niile ga-agbanwe: taabụ, bọtịnụ, tooltips, ozi.
- AI sụgharịrị asụsụ ọ bụla site na panel Bekee, ọ bụghị okwu
  site n'okwu. Aha ndị ị na-ahụ na project gị (aha layer, aha effect) ga-anọgide
  n'asụsụ Bekee ka ha na-ekwekọ na After Effects.
- A sụgharịrị popup "ihe ọhụrụ" ahụ nakwa, malite na mbipụta a.

ỌHỤRỤ: THEME DEMON SLAYER
- Flex Ntọala > NHỌPỤTA THEME nwere otu DEMON SLAYER ọhụrụ nwere theme 11:
  Giyu, Hinokami Kagura, Shinobu, Mitsuri, Rengoku, Zenitsu, Nezuko,
  Muichiro, Inosuke, Tengen na Kokushibo.
- Bugharịa mouse n'elu panel, element nke theme ga-esoro ya: mmiri,
  ire ọkụ, ọkụ eluigwe, urukpuru, akwụkwọ okooko osisi, ntụ mmiri na ndị ọzọ. Mgbe mouse
  kwụsịrị, ọ na-apụ n'anya nwayọọ.
- Pịa bọtịnụ, mma agha agwa ahụ ga-egbutu ya. Jide bọtịnụ aka ekpe
  ka ọ na-aga n'ihu na-egbutu; jide ya ihe dị ka sekọnd 2.5, ọ ga-agbawa.
- Emere ya ka ọ dịrị mfe: effects na-agba naanị mgbe ị na-ebugharị mouse ma ọ bụ na-apịa, ma ha
  na-adị mfe n'onwe ha na kọmputa ndị nwayọọ. Gbanyụọ EFFECTS GBURUGBURU
  na NHỌPỤTA THEME iji debe naanị agba.

GBANWEERE: BỌTỊNỤ DỊ LARỊỊ N'THEME NILE
- Bọtịnụ na-arụ ọrụ na bọtịnụ isi na theme agba anaghịzi eji gradient ndò site
  n'elu ruo n'ala. Ha bụ otu agba dị larịị nwere ìhè dị nro, ya mere ha
  na-adị ọcha ma na-agụ nke ọma.

EMEZIRI
- Kaadị ikikere na popup "ihe ọhụrụ" nwere ike imeghe n'elu ibe ha. Ugbu a
  ha anaghị ekpuchi ibe ha ma ọlị, bajị UPDATE anaghịkwa ekpuchi
  bọtịnụ ndị dị n'elu panel ahụ.
- Na UI SCALE 125% na 150%, windo ụfọdụ (dị ka Flex Ntọala) nwere ike
  ịdị ogologo karịa panel, ya mere bọtịnụ imechi ha pụrụ n'anya. Windo ọ bụla
  ugbu a kwekọrọ n'ọkara ọ bụla.
- Windows: AutoCaptions nwere ike ikwu "NVIDIA DRIVER DỊ OCHIE KARỊA MAKA GPU
  CAPTIONS" na kaadị na driver ọhụrụ (RTX 40 na 50 series). Ugbu a ọ na-agụ
  nkwado CUDA nke driver ahụ nke ọma ma jiri GPU gị.

ENWEGHỊ NGBANWE
- Ikikere, activation na njikọ niile na-arụ ọrụ otu ha si arụ ọrụ na mbụ.
- Taabụ na ngwa ọrụ ọzọ niile na-arụ ọrụ otu ha si arụ ọrụ na 9.2.7.
================================================================================

FLEX ULTIMATE MAKA PREMIERE PRO - IHE ỌHỤRỤ
Nsụgharị 2.2.8  -  Ọktọba 2026

Captions CAPTION STACK bụzi template Motion Graphics NWERE IKE IDEZIGHARỊ nwere editor n'ezie,
e nwere AUDIO STUDIO ọhụrụ na MARK AUDIO BEATS, panel na-asụ ASỤSỤ 132, UI SCALE abịaruola
na ULTIMATE, ma e nwekwara THEME DEMON SLAYER ọhụrụ.

TUPU Ị MALITE
- Wụnye ya n'elu nsụgharị ị nwere ugbu a site na ZXP installer gị nkịtị, wee malitegharịa
  Premiere Pro otu ugboro.
- A ga-edebe ntọala gị, theme gị na preset gị.

ỌHỤRỤ: CAPTION STACK - CAPTIONS NWERE IKE IDEZIGHARỊ (FX & ADV RIGS > CAPTION STACK)
- A na-etinye captions ugbu a dị ka template Motion Graphics nwere ike idezigharị (Output >
  EDITABLE MOGRT, nke bụ ihe ndabara ọhụrụ na Premiere Pro 2026). Mgbe e tinyechara,
  gbanwee okwu ọ bụla, font, agba, nha, ọnọdụ, glow, outline, igbe,
  animation ma ọ bụ oge na panel Essential Graphics nke Premiere.
- Output > IMAGES ka na-etinye okwu ọ bụla dị ka foto nwere otu ọdịdị ahụ,
  ma ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ nke ị chọrọ.
- Template ndị ahụ na panel na-abịa. Enweghị ihe ị ga-ebudata.

ỌHỤRỤ: EDITOR CAPTION STACK
- Nlele ugbu a na-egosi fraịm vidiyo gị n'ezie n'okpuru caption ọ bụla.
- Dọrọ caption ka ibugharị ya, jiri akuku ahụ gbanwee nha ya na ntụpọ dị n'elu
  ka ịtụgharịa ya, pịa okwu ugboro abụọ ka idezigharị ya. CAPTION NIILE na-ebugharị okwu niile
  ọnụ, OTU OKWU na-ebugharị otu okwu.
- Họrọ ma mgbanwe na-emetụta caption niile ma ọ bụ caption a naanị, wee
  chekwaa nhazi gị ka ị jiri ya ọzọ.
- Ọdịdị GLOW ọhụrụ 10: Big Wide, Bounce Lime, Candy, Horror, Hook, Typewriter,
  Editorial, Sunset, Slide Yellow na Superb.

ỌHỤRỤ: AUDIO STUDIO (FX & ADV RIGS > AUDIO STUDIO)
- Họrọ audio clip, họrọ effect wee pịa APPLY. Ihe niile na-agba n'elu
  kọmputa gị.
- Preset 30 nke otu ntụpọ: Underwater, Bass Boost, Room / Hall / Cathedral /
  Plate reverb, Echo, Telephone, Radio, Megaphone, Robot, Chipmunk, Deep
  Voice, Nightcore, Slowed + Reverb, 8D Audio, Lo-fi, Reverse na ndị ọzọ. Kwakọba
  effects ọtụtụ dị ka ị chọrọ, hazigharịa ha ma ọ bụ gbanyụọ otu.
- Reverb na-ejide ọdụ ya: ụda na-agbasa gafere ngwụsị clip ahụ, a na-edekwa ya
  ka ihe ọ bụla dị na timeline gị ghara ịkpochapụ.
- Ngwa: Noise Remover, Voice Enhance, Loudness (-14 / -16 / -23 LUFS),
  De-esser, De-click, De-clip, Hum Remover, Compressor, Limiter, EQ, Speed
  na Pitch, Noise Gate, Extract Audio.
- STEMS MAKER na-ekewa egwu n'olu na egwu (ma ọ bụ stem 4). Ọ na-ebudata
  model ya mgbe mbụ, ma jụọ gị ya tupu ọ bido.
- PREVIEW na-ahapụ gị ka ị nụ ihe dị ka sekọnd 8 site na switch Original / Processed.
  A na-edebe nsonaazụ ahụ na audio track efu, a gbanyụọkwa ụda clip mbụ gị,
  a naghị ehichapụ ya ma ọlị.

ỌHỤRỤ: MARK AUDIO BEATS (FX & ADV RIGS > MARK AUDIO BEATS)
- Họrọ music clip na timeline wee pịa MARK BEATS: Flex na-achọta
  beats ma tinye sequence markers na ha, ka ịkpụ gị gbanye
  n'egwu ahụ kpọmkwem.
- Họrọ ALL hits, KICKS ma ọ bụ SNARES, setịpụ mmetụta, ma were beat ọ bụla ma ọ bụ
  beat nke 2 ma ọ bụ nke 4 ọ bụla.
- REMOVE BEAT MARKERS na-ehichapụ naanị markers Flex tinyere. Ọ na-agba
  na kọmputa gị.

ỌHỤRỤ: PANEL N'ASỤSỤ 132
- Ntọala > ASỤSỤ na-edepụta asụsụ 132 ugbu a, nwere igbe ọchọcha. Taabụ,
  bọtịnụ, tooltips na ozi niile na-agbanwe. A sụgharịrị popup "ihe ọhụrụ" ahụ
  nakwa, malite na mbipụta a.

ỌHỤRỤ: UI SCALE
- Ntọala > UI SCALE na-eme ka panel niile buru ibu ma ọ bụ pere mpe, dị ka na
  Flex GUI Pro. Windo ọ bụla kwekọrọ n'ọkara ọ bụla.
